backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no exposed functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, related files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of multiple frontend files for documentation or analysis.
frontend/.env.example: Example env file showing where to set the ActivePieces webhook URL used by the app.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining how to create a build draft, deploy, verify, and troubleshoot the app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS layer defining OKLCH color tokens, theme variables, and styling for light/dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the Vite-built React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top‑level component that checks Internet Identity auth state and renders either SignInPage or DashboardPage.
frontend/src/components/AskAI/AskAIModul: UI component for asking AI questions with input, loading states, errors, and response display.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: Drag‑and‑drop file upload component supporting PDF/TXT/MD with preview, clear, and upload actions.
App layout wrapper with header, footer, and sign-out button surrounding page content.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/Interactive: Interactive quiz renderer showing questions and options with correct/incorrect highlighting logic.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/QuizSection: Renders a quiz section with show/hide and delete controls, embedding InteractiveQuiz when visible.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Displays a text summary with optional delete action, or a placeholder when no summary exists.
frontend/src/components/WebhookSetupHelp: Provides UI to view, set, validate, and clear a saved webhook URL with feedback messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and tracks a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and identity loading via a React context provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/activepieces.ts: Uploads files or sends AI questions via webhook, falling back to offline processing and enforcing strict response validation.
frontend/src/lib/env.ts: Resolves the active webhook URL from overrides or env vars and provides a utility to check configuration.
frontend/src/lib/offlineNoteProcessing.t: Handles extracting text from uploaded files, creating summaries with truncation rules, and generating up to 10 quiz questions from text.
frontend/src/lib/pdfTextExtraction.ts: Loads PDF.js from CDN and extracts text from all PDF pages in the browser, returning combined plain text.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for quiz items, upload responses, and AI responses.
frontend/src/lib/webhookOverride.ts: Manages a user-defined webhook URL in localStorage with validation, saving, retrieving, and clearing helpers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with file upload, summary display, quiz display, and error handling for uploads.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Provides the sign‑in UI using Internet Identity, including login handling and basic error feedback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme extensions, plugins, colors, fonts, and animations for the frontend.
frontend/WEBHOOK_SETUP.md: Documentation describing how to configure the ActivePieces webhook URL for processing notes and AI queries.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, known issues, feature requirements, and metadata for the Notes Quizzer project.
